products.name: Pivot AI Operating System for Procurement
products.description: 一个企业级AI采购操作系统，从记录系统层面构建，覆盖寻源、审批、采购、发票、付款、预算、费用和报告等完整采购生命周期，并提供实时ERP集成。
products.target_customers: 大型企业，特别是拥有复杂多实体结构和ERP系统的财务与采购团队
features: 与数十个ERP系统的实时集成
支持复杂的多实体企业结构

evidence_refs.quote: The platform covers sourcing, approvals, purchasing, invoicing, payments, budgets, expenses and reporting inside a single environment, with real-time ERP integrations and support for multi-entity enterprise structures.
